SELECT COUNT(*),SUM(ms_up_32 IS NOT NULL),
SUM(ms_up_32 IS NOT NULL AND (ms_sl IS NULL OR ms_up_32<ms_sl)),
SUM(ms_up_32 IS NOT NULL AND ms_sl IS NOT NULL AND ms_up_32>ms_sl),SUM(tp_pct<3.2)
FROM outcomes WHERE strategy_version='f82bcff' AND sombra=0 AND cerrado=1
AND ts_open<=? AND cobertura_velas>=.98 AND (ms_up_32 IS NULL OR ms_up_32 BETWEEN 0 AND 86400000) AND (ms_sl IS NULL OR ms_sl BETWEEN 0 AND 86400000) AND (ms_tp IS NULL OR ms_tp BETWEEN 0 AND 86400000) AND (ms_mfe IS NULL OR ms_mfe BETWEEN 0 AND 86400000) AND (ms_mae IS NULL OR ms_mae BETWEEN 0 AND 86400000)
